## Checklist

- [ ] Every `feat:` commit is preceded by its failing `test:` commit (TDD)
- [ ] Tests cite the requirement IDs they cover
- [ ] Public classes and methods have TSDoc; `.env.example` updated if config changed
- [ ] No business logic in controllers (Server Actions / route handlers)
- [ ] Reviewer verdict posted as a PR comment
- [ ] Doc-sync done by `analyst` (REQ/TASK status, README, CHANGELOG, diagrams)
- [ ] Failures during this phase recorded in `docs/pipeline/failures.md`
